# `aitbc simulate network`

Simulate network nodes, delays, and failure rates.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc simulate network [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--nodes` | integer | `3` | no | Number of nodes to simulate |
| `--network-delay` | float | `0.1` | no | Network delay in seconds |
| `--failure-rate` | float | `0.05` | no | Node failure rate (0.0-1.0) |
| `--seed` | integer | — | no | Seed for deterministic simulation (default: live) |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc simulate network
```
